Watering rota

In a dry summer the members take turns to water the shared beds by the gate. The rota is pinned up on the board in June, after the summer inspection, with two names for every evening of the week. If you cannot come on your evening, change with someone and write the new names on the board.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
